name: Her Good Horses
role: quillworker and Kills in Winter's wife
want: keep her children safe and her family fed through a summer of war
secret: She has a Cheyenne cousin married to a trader at Julesburg, and sends him word in secret, hoping to buy her family a way out if the war goes badly.
description: A quillworker whose work is known in every Oglala camp; she survived the Sand Creek winter among her Cheyenne kin.
appearance: A quilled dress of her own making, a child on her hip more often than not.
